annotations.title: Search the words in every text

description: Find passages by the words inside them, across every Bible edition and every work, in every language (title-only search is search_shelf). Query: words, "an exact phrase", -leave out, author: work: group: lang: edition:. Returns results[] (work or edition, section, paragraph or verse, anchor, snippet with matches in « », the parallel text, url, cite), next_cursor, total_estimate, facets. Phrase hits rank above all-words above some; at most 2 per work. Example: {"query": "love your enemies", "scope": "bible"}. If empty: fewer words, no quotes, scope "all", or the word in the original language.
